# Is the insurer's direct repair program worth signing for your body shop?

> Free collision repair DRP calculator: your labor rates, the insurer's rate cut, parts discount and materials cap, repriced jobs and promised volume in; profit with and without the program, break-even repair orders and the lowest labor rate worth accepting out. Nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
